## What happened?

Describe the expected behavior and what actually happened. Include the exact error.

Check the [known-issues page](https://github.com/moldymichael/LetraCode/blob/main/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) and search open issues first. If the failure is already tracked, add new environment or reproduction evidence there instead of opening a duplicate.

## Evidence

Paste relevant logs or attach screenshots. Remove credentials, private conversations, receipts and sensitive paths. Do not attach a full application database or model weights.

## Scope

Does it reproduce with disposable application data and sample files? Have you found an existing related issue? Do not delete live data to answer these questions. Reporting the failure is enough; a fix is not required.
